$comment: Theme contract version 1: the paths a theme directory holds and the token names its built sheets declare. A path is a glob relative to the theme directory, where * stays inside one path segment and ** spans any number. A required token name counts as defined only when the theme's own built sheets (tokens/tokens.css and each options/<key>/<value>.css) declare it in each color mode and each option value, never when a chassis or engine default computes it. The required names are the root names the public theme equivalence fixture (examples/showcase/e2e/fixtures/public-theme-computed.json) reads, minus the chassis-only names below, which the engine or daisyUI supply, plus the two roles that joined after that fixture was captured, --cairn-eyebrow-case and --cairn-scroll-cue.

chassisOnly.name: color-scheme
chassisOnly.reason: Set by each color mode's daisyUI block from its color-scheme option; a theme names its modes in cairn-theme.json and never declares it as a token.

chassisOnly.name: --flow-space
chassisOnly.reason: Derived by the engine's role defaults in cairn-public.css; a theme may override it.

chassisOnly.name: --depth
chassisOnly.reason: A daisyUI effect knob that daisyUI defaults; a theme may set it in its daisyUI blocks.

chassisOnly.name: --noise
chassisOnly.reason: A daisyUI effect knob that daisyUI defaults; a theme may set it in its daisyUI blocks.
